name: aspect_pass1_discovery
description: Free-form aspect extraction. The model invents its own aspect labels — useful as the first pass of a two-pass pipeline. Run this on a small sample, look at which labels come up most often, then build a clean taxonomy for Pass 2.
prompt:
Extract aspects discussed in this text.

For each aspect return an object with:
- "aspect": short name (e.g. "acting", "plot", "music")
- "sentiment": "positive", "negative", or "neutral"
- "quote": short supporting quote from the text

Return JSON: {"aspects": [ ... ]}

TEXT:
{target}
